messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) Calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is panicking
You should choose Calm because Emily stays calm and focused, enabling better decision making.
Here are the two options available: (A) keep and (B) GIVE. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Either keep flare gun or give to Matt
You should choose Keep the flare gun because it gives Emily direct control over signaling for help.
Here are the two options available: (A) Stow and (B) Shoot. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Decision to fire the flare gun
You should choose Stow the flare gun because it preserves the flare for future signaling.
Here are the two options available: (A) Persist and (B) Comply. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is answering the park ranger
You should choose Persist because it clearly conveys the urgency of the situation to the ranger.
Here are the two options available: (A) Persist and (B) Inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is still talking to the park ranger
You should choose Persist because it clearly conveys the urgency to the ranger.
Here are the two options available: (A) Suspicious and (B) Supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is hanging, will Matt save her?
You should choose Suspicious because it prompts Matt to confront the situation directly and take decisive action to save Emily.
Here are the two options available: (A) Sarcastic and (B) Concerned. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Matt is still trying to save Emily
You should choose Sarcastic because it sharpens Matt's resolve to push through and save Emily.
Here are the two options available: (A) Insist and (B) Concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Ashley is trying to convince Chris about a ghost
You should choose Insist because it reinforces Ashley's certainty and pushes Chris to acknowledge the ghost 👻.
Here are the two options available: (A) Dismissive and (B) Sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Ashley is talking with Chris on Hannah
You should choose Dismissive because it keeps Ashley focused on the task and avoids getting bogged down in emotional drama. 👻

Here are the two options available: (A) reluctant and (B) courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Chris is trying to convince Ashley to go down the stairs
You should choose Reluctant because it keeps Ashley cautious and focused on getting through safely 🧭.
